rules: Map requirements into the existing T One architecture; never create a second universal Agent or model gateway.
A mother-document claim is a requirement candidate, not a platform fact.
Official current evidence and observed software outrank the mother document and seller experience.
Planned, named, configured or visible capabilities are not implemented or connected capabilities.

items.mother_requirement: Separate marketplace commerce, independent commerce, and external media channels.
items.existing_capability: platform expert registry and cross-channel advertising taxonomy already separate eBay marketplace ads from independent-site channels
items.gap: eBay Offsite can still be misread as a Google Ads account
items.minimal_fusion_path: keep eBay General/Priority/Offsite inside the eBay Marketing domain and retain the existing cross-channel measurement core

items.mother_requirement: Keep marketplace on-site ads distinct from independent-site external ads.
items.existing_capability: shared advertising agent already provides measurement, profit, draft, approval and stop-loss primitives
items.gap: no real eBay Marketing authorization
items.minimal_fusion_path: add an eBay-specific adapter contract and do not duplicate the advertising runtime

items.mother_requirement: Switch between specialized platform experts from the product surface.
items.existing_capability: platform_expert_registry, Skill/plugin/model/connector entry points and C1 expert shell exist
items.gap: eBay page-to-save-to-real-call-to-writeback loop is not implemented
items.minimal_fusion_path: register this existing Skill/contract through the shared integration task only after C4 is available

items.mother_requirement: Every expert should master every mainstream and niche tool automatically.
items.existing_capability: T One has connection-state labels and a capability registry
items.gap: tool names such as WatchCount/Terapeak do not prove access, license, API or mastery
items.minimal_fusion_path: record each tool as research_only/available_unconnected/connected_read_only/connected_write_gated/blocked using actual evidence

items.mother_requirement: Continuously collect official updates, seller experience, video and GitHub projects.
items.existing_capability: versioned learning and project automation foundations exist
items.gap: eBay lacked a dedicated evidence-first cursor, failure log and recurring job
items.minimal_fusion_path: use the eBay-only daily automation, official-first evidence taxonomy and no-increment rule

items.mother_requirement: Do not disrupt working product functionality while extending expertise.
items.existing_capability: C1 formal Windows package, T1 mark, one-store primary conversation and task-context isolation are completed
items.gap: shared C4 integration is occupied/pending
items.minimal_fusion_path: write only eBay-owned Skill/config/test/report assets and submit shared-core suggestions

items.mother_requirement: Use Chinese forums and content communities as learning sources.
items.existing_capability: public research workflow exists
items.gap: source quality, copyright, access permission, sample and site scope vary
items.minimal_fusion_path: store only seller_hypothesis-style experiment candidates; never promote to official rules

items.mother_requirement: Use overseas video, social groups, forums and eBay community sources.
items.existing_capability: browser/public research and content analysis foundations exist
items.gap: logged-in/private group rights and data-use permission are not established
items.minimal_fusion_path: use public permitted pages only, record provenance, and keep anecdotal claims as experiments

items.mother_requirement: Automatically bypass anti-scraping controls on overseas sites.
items.existing_capability: none authorized
items.gap: the requirement violates platform/access boundaries
items.minimal_fusion_path: use official pages/APIs, robots/terms/rate limits and legal browser sessions; stop at CAPTCHA/MFA/access controls

items.mother_requirement: Check platform official university, announcements, policies and algorithms daily.

items.gap: not all pages publish dates and some official pages conflict

items.mother_requirement: Promote seller experience to standard knowledge after three sellers agree.

items.gap: seller agreement is not first-party authority and may be site/category specific
